text:
kevin_s: Gamma POC (gamma-inc-poc) — their free credits hit zero after two short test runs. They say it used ~60k tokens but only expected ~6k. Can someone triage?

isabel_sales: On it. Can you paste the account id and any logs they shared?

kevin_s: account: gamma-inc-poc. Customer pasted terminal output and header dump. They ran the node sdk twice and saw balance drop immediately. Snippet they sent:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
-H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" 
-d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"summary...","stream":true}'

# response headers (customer):
# x-req-id: req_0b9f2a
# x-total-tokens: 62345
# x-billed-tokens: 62345
```

maria_support: Thanks — do they use our Node SDK or direct HTTP? Also any retries in the client?

alex_p: Quick check: we had a bug in older SDKs where streaming retries could create duplicate server-side billing for the same session if the client retried mid-stream. Which sdk version?

isabel_sales: Customer said node SDK v1.1.8 and that their app does a simple retry-on-429 with no idempotency keys. They also call generate then an immediate append for post-processing.

maria_support: Reproduced locally with 1.1.8 + a simulated 429 during handshake. What happens: client retries the streaming start, server accepts two separate streaming sessions that both consume token accounting for the same prompt. We should have dropped the duplicate once we finalize billing, but there's a race where both sessions get billed. Repro log:
```
[2026-03-15T17:12:10Z] incoming start stream req_id=req_0b9f2a
[2026-03-15T17:12:11Z] throttle -> 429 returned to client
[2026-03-15T17:12:11Z] client retry -> new connection req_id=req_0b9f2b
[2026-03-15T17:12:15Z] both sessions finished -> billing: tokens=62345,62345
```

alex_p: Yep that's the race. There was an idempotency header check we added later (x-session-id) but node SDK 1.1.8 didn't send it for streaming starts. I can draft a patch to server-side dedupe and push an SDK patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3456 (WIP).

billing_bot: ALERT: potential duplicate charge events for gamma-inc-poc between 2026-03-15T17:12Z and 2026-03-15T17:15Z. Invoice lines flagged for review.

sre-jordan: We can issue a usage credit for duplicates once support confirms counts. Recommend temporary mitigation: tell the customer to upgrade to node SDK >=1.2.1 which sends x-session-id, and add exponential backoff on 429s.

isabel_sales: Proposed remediation to customer: (1) immediate 20% credit to make them whole while we investigate, (2) guidance to upgrade SDK and add backoff, (3) ETA for server patch 48h. Approve? :thinking_face:

kevin_s: Customer accepted the 20% credit. They want a short blurb we can send to their engs about retries/streaming. Can support draft that? :pray:

maria_support: Will draft a 3-bullet note: 1) upgrade SDK to 1.2.1+, 2) include an idempotency/session header for streaming starts, 3) use jittered exponential backoff on 429s. I'll also attach the temporary credit reconciliation and a link to the PR.

isabel_sales: Thanks team — please add a short internal postmortem once the patch lands so we can avoid repeats on other POCs.

kevin_s: Closing loop with the customer now. Will update thread when patch hits prod. Thanks all :thumbsup:
